```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(limma)

load("RData_files/initial_fullddsdesigncountsVsdcountsWGCNA.RData")
```


```{r}
transformed_counts<-as.matrix(assay(Vsd))
str(transformed_counts) #44 samples

# calculate sample distances
sample_dists <- assay(Vsd) %>%
  t() %>%
  dist(., method = "manhattan") %>%
  as.matrix() 

mdsData <- data.frame(cmdscale(sample_dists))
mds <- cbind(mdsData, as.data.frame(colData(Vsd))) # combine with sample data
head(mds)

treatment_data <- mds %>% select(!Genotype)

ggplot(mds, aes(X1, X2, color = Treatment)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  stat_ellipse(type = "norm", level = 0.95) + 
  labs(x="nMDS1", y="nMDS2")
```
